title: Add demotion and recovery paths to MemoryStateMachine
description: MemoryStateMachine only promotes (Unconsolidated -> Working -> Core) or drops to Deprecated. No demotion path exists (Core -> Working or Working -> Unconsolidated). A deprecated memory is unrecoverable through the state machine. Add demotion transitions and a recovery path from Deprecated. Split the monolithic Evaluate method into focused methods: EvaluatePromotion, EvaluateDemotion, ShouldPromoteToCore, ShouldDeprecate. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P2-002
